subject: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@seabreezelodging.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan

Evan —

Thanks again for confirming the block for our leadership workshop (Oct 29–31). A few operational items we need to lock this week so finance and ops can close the PO and we can publish attendee logistics: 

1) Master bill split: we need the master invoice to be split three ways: Redwood Ops (room nights), Redwood Events (F&B & meeting rooms), and ClientCo (incidentals for their sponsored attendees). Please provide the accounting codes fields you can include on the master bill or a CSV layout we can use.

2) Shuttle windows: our attendee arrival pattern is staggered: five arrival waves (0730, 0900, 1130, 1500, 1830). Can you confirm 12- and 20-passenger shuttle availability for those windows and an estimated per-trip rate?

3) In-room pantry kits: we want a small welcome pantry (snacks + single-serve beverages) in 40 rooms. We need a dietary preference tagging system (vegetarian, gluten-free, nut-free). If you can share your pantry inventory template, we'll map dietary flags to each attendee.

4) Late arrivals & key handoffs: for guests arriving after 22:00 we prefer a pre-keyed check-in envelope at concierge rather than late-night desk staffing. Can Olivia confirm we can have labeled envelopes and a signature log?

Attachments: none from our side yet — if you can send your rates and a pantry inventory template that would be ideal.

Goal: have a draft master-bill split CSV and shuttle estimate by Tue EOD so finance can start the PO.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@seabreezelodging.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Kent <olivia.kent@seabreezelodging.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan

Markus —

Thanks for the clear notes. Responses below and I attached the detailed rate sheet and pantry template (rates_schedule.xlsx; pantry_inventory_template.pdf).

1) Master bill / split: we can export the master bill with three custom charge codes. I've attached a sample CSV layout (masterbill_split_proposal.csv) — it includes columns for charge_code, department_name, description, amount, and client_reference. We can also add up to two free-text fields at billing time for reconciliations (PO number / internal approval).

2) Shuttle: we have both sizes available. Per-trip estimates (one-way) are: 12-passenger shuttle $95, 20-passenger shuttle $140. If you pre-book all five windows each day we can guarantee dedicated vehicles for the morning slots. Fuel surcharge may apply for runs after 1800.

3) Pantry kits: we can do 40 kits. Template indicates standard kit (6 items) at $18/kit, premium at $28/kit. Dietary tags are supported — delivery team will affix a colored sticker for each tag (V/ GF/ NF). Please provide a column in your attendee sheet with the dietary tag.

4) Late arrivals: Olivia confirms we can hold pre-keyed envelopes at concierge with a signed pickup log. We'll include a printed list of expected late arrivals in the concierge binder.

Next steps: I've attached the files; happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to run through the CSV mapping.

Best,
Evan Shaw
Director of Sales — Seabreeze Hotel & Conference Center
[attachment: rates_schedule.xlsx (xlsx); attachment: pantry_inventory_template.pdf (pdf); attachment: masterbill_split_proposal.csv (csv)]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@seabreezelodging.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:36:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan

Markus / Evan —

Quick clarifications from ops/finance side before we lock: 
- For the master bill CSV, can the hotel include the tax and service charge as separate line items per department? We need tax lines by department for internal allocation.
- For shuttle billing, will the shuttle be invoiced per trip or consolidated daily? Consolidated daily is easier for our AP.
- Pantry dietary tags: we'll supply a dietary column in the attendee spreadsheet and can flag VIPs who should receive premium kits.

If the hotel can provide a sample filled-in CSV with the taxes and one shuttle consolidated line that'd speed PO creation.

Thanks — I'll start the PO draft once we have the sample CSV.

—Monica
Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@seabreezelodging.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan

Folks —

Finance here. A couple items we need to finalize before issuing the PO: 
1) Legal name and remit address for Seabreeze (for contract & W9).
2) Confirmation whether taxes are estimated or exact (hotel will show taxes and service once final rooming is confirmed — we need an estimate line).
3) Is the master bill payable to Redwood with split cost centers, or should we set up three separate invoices to each Redwood cost center? Our preference is a single master invoice with pre-coded splits.

If Seabreeze can send a short billing addendum with the remit details and confirm the invoice split approach we'll attach it to the PO.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@seabreezelodging.com>, Olivia Kent <olivia.kent@seabreezelodging.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Willis <sarah.willis@clientco.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Master billing, shuttle windows, and in-room pantry plan

Team —

Thanks everyone. Evan / Olivia — can you: 
- Provide remit name & address + a one-paragraph billing addendum confirming you will deliver a single master invoice with three charge codes and separate tax lines (per Monica's ask).
- Return a sample masterbill_split_proposal.csv populated with one sample room night, one shuttle consolidated daily line, and the two tax/service lines.
- Confirm shuttle consolidated daily billing (yes/no) and whether the fuel surcharge will be applied after 1800.

Monica / Laura — I'll drop the attendee sheet into the linked rooming and billing Google Sheet today (see link above). I'll mark VIPs for premium pantry kits. Sarah — adding you for visibility on the sponsor incidentals.

If we get those items by Fri EOD we'll finalize the PO next week and publish the attendee arrival email.

Cheers,
Markus
Head of Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
